subject: Questionnaire route proposal & legal/ops clarifying questions
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@lumenhealth.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questionnaire route proposal & legal/ops clarifying questions

Hi Samantha / Marco —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed path forward for the security/compliance work so we can keep the procurement cycle moving: 

Summary from our side:
- LumenHealth is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing summarization and search (low-latency inference).
- You flagged HIPAA coverage for PHI, SOC 2 as a preference, and a desire for clear control mappings into your vendor risk platform.

Recommendation (two options):
1) SIG (Full SIG questionnaire) — best for control-level mapping into your risk tool and for SOC 2/HIPAA evidence alignment. We can provide a prefilled SIG to accelerate review.
2) CAIQ / Short-form profile — faster to complete if you only need a security posture snapshot and are planning a limited integration.

Clarifying questions (quick answers will help us pick the right form):
- Do you need a completed SIG matrix with control owners (preferred) or a CAIQ-style snapshot to start?
- Is SOC 2 Type II required before contract signature, or is it acceptable as a post-signature deliverable with an agreed remediation plan?
- Do you require customer-managed encryption keys (bring-your-own-key) or is platform-managed encryption acceptable for now?
- Any specific data residency requirements (US-only) or regional controls for where inference occurs?
- Timeline target for procurement / security sign-off?

Attachments: vendor-questionnaire-options.pdf (comparison SIG vs CAIQ), vendor-sig-vs-caiq-matrix.xlsx (suggested prefills).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm preferred questionnaire route + timeline (answers to the clarifying Qs above)
- If SIG: we’ll send a prefilled spreadsheet and schedule a 30m technical walk-through with Camila next week
- If CAIQ: we send the short-form within 48 hours

CCing Camila (solutions) and Kimberly (compliance) so they can jump in on technical/evidence questions.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@lumenhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questionnaire route proposal & legal/ops clarifying questions

Rishi — thanks for the summary. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Preferred route: SIG would be ideal because our vendor risk platform ingests SIG mappings. If Redwood can prefill, that will speed things considerably.
- SOC 2: We need SOC 2 Type II evidence prior to a final procurement approval; if full Type II isn’t available we can consider a Plan + timeline but it will affect the approval window.
- Encryption keys: We prefer customer-managed keys for production PHI, but can accept platform-managed keys for a short pilot if we have an explicit migration plan.
- Data residency: US-only for production, pilot can be hosted in our US region.
- Timeline: aim to complete security review by end of next month (June 30).

Looping procurement contact (procurement@lumenhealth.com) on specifics for contracting.

Thanks —
Samantha Li
Security & Privacy Program Manager
LumenHealth
samantha.li@lumenhealth.com

Thanks Samantha — good clarity. A few technical details to call out so you can map into the SIG answers: 

- KMS / BYOK: Redwood supports customer-managed keys. For our Hosted API we integrate with cloud KMS providers and we also offer HSM-backed key management in Dedicated/Private deployments. If you need BYOK for prod PHI, we’ll note that as a requirement in the SIG prefill and provide the integration playbook.

- Hosting & data residency: Production inference can be pinned to a US region (we have both east/west options). For pilot runs we can use our standard hosted cluster but will segregate tenant data logically; dedicated or on-prem deployments are available for stricter isolation.

- Data handling: We do not persist prompt/response content beyond caching windows needed for KV/prefix caching. We can provide a data retention policy excerpt and the relevant SOC 2 control mappings for data lifecycle (will attach).

- Evidence & owners: For SIG prefill we’ll assign control owners and attach SOC 2 summary artifacts that we can share under an NDA. Kimberly — I’ve flagged the SOC 2 status in the prefill notes (see attachment).

If you confirm SIG, next week I can run a 30m technical walkthrough to show the KMS integration and dataflow diagrams. Suggested slots: Wed 5/12 10:00-10:30 or Thu 5/13 15:00-15:30 PT.

Best —
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
(attachment: redwood-dataflow-kms.pdf)
